metadata.oracle_evidence: solution/trajectory.npz replays the validated Sharpa Wave episode on the Marvin right arm (1,595 controls; success after 1,475, then 120 unexecuted hold rows of slack): pinch and lift as in the floating-stage episode, a planned joint-space change of the arm's IK branch while the plug is carried, closed-loop alignment in front of the desk edge, insertion into port 4, release and a 1 s released hold. Two fresh-process replays succeed with identical state hashes, and the rows rounded to float32 also succeed. The standard oracle submits the same rows through the public client.

notes.layout: Each row starts with the 14 Marvin arm joint targets (left arm J1-J7, then right arm J1-J7), followed by the left hand's finger targets and then the right hand's (22 per hand for `sharpa`, 20 per hand for `wuji`); the left arm is parked and only the right arm/hand perform the task.
